map.计算车辆装载的体积利用率与重量利用率，判断是体积受限还是重量受限，并估算可装载件: Compute a vehicle's volume and weight utilization to judge whether volume or weight is the binding constraint, and estimate the piece count that fits.
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：对 3 种正交摆放取向 (长,宽,高)、(长,高,宽)、: Maximum piece count (volume side): for the 3 orthogonal orientations (length, width, height), (length, height, width), (width, height, length), compute floor(car length ÷ first side) × floor(car width ÷ second side) × floor(car height ÷ third side) and take the largest of the three as the volume ceiling.
map.重量约束与受限类型判定：受重量限制的最大件数=floor(车辆载重÷单件重量)，: Weight constraint and binding type: maximum pieces by weight = floor(vehicle payload ÷ unit weight), and final maximum pieces = min(volume ceiling, weight ceiling). When the volume ceiling is at most the weight ceiling it is 'volume limited', otherwise 'weight limited', which decides the optimization direction (change stacking or switch to a higher payload vehicle).
map.计划装载校验：按计划件数计算总体积与总重量及对应利用率，超过体积上限标「超装」、: Planned loading check: from the planned piece count compute total volume, total weight and the utilization rates; over the volume ceiling is marked 'over volume', over the weight ceiling 'over weight', and utilization above 90% 'near full load', for reviewing before dispatch whether to add a truck or reduce the load.
map.算例：6.8 m 厢车装 0.6×0.4×0.5 m 纸箱: Worked example: a 6.8 m van loaded with 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m cartons
map.：输入：车厢 6.8×2.3×2.4 m（容积 37.536 m³）、载重 50: : input: cargo box 6.8 × 2.3 × 2.4 m (volume 37.536 m³), payload 5000 kg; cartons 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m (0.12 m³ each), 15 kg each; planned 500 pieces. Three orientations: (0.6,0.4,0.5) -> 11 × 5 × 4 = 220 pieces, (0.6,0.5,0.4) -> 11 × 4 × 6 = 264 pieces, (0.4,0.5,0.6) -> 17 × 4 × 4 = 272 pieces, take the max 272. Weight ceiling = floor(5000 ÷ 15) = 333 pieces. Maximum pieces = min(272, 333) = 272, binding type = volume limited; at 272 pieces volume utilization is 87.0% and weight utilization 81.6%. The planned 500 pieces need 60.00 m³ (159.8%) and 7500 kg (150.0%), over both volume and weight limits, so split into two trucks or reduce; if changed to 300 pieces then 36.00 m³ (95.9%) and 4500 kg (90.0%), still above the 272-piece volume ceiling, so it still will not fit.
map.为什么每个方向用向下取整而不是四舍五入？: Why round down rather than to nearest in every direction?
map.车厢三边不可切分，任一方向只能放下整数件，向下取整保证不越界。同时实际装车还要扣: The three sides of the cargo box cannot be split, and each direction can only hold whole pieces, so rounding down guarantees no overrun. Actual loading also has to deduct pallet thickness, cargo gaps, door frame inset and stacking error, so multiply the tool result by a 0.90-0.95 real-load factor as an executable loading plan.
map.只试 3 种摆放取向够吗？长方体不是有 6 种吗？: Is testing only 3 orientations enough? Doesn't a cuboid have 6?
map.长方体正交摆放确有 6 种，但绕竖直轴旋转 180° 只是交换另外两边，在向下取: A cuboid does have 6 orthogonal orientations, but rotating 180° about the vertical axis merely swaps the other two sides, which in a floor-counting model is equivalent to one already enumerated, so 3 orientations cover all distinct side assignments. If the goods may not be inverted (for example cartons marked 'this side up'), manually remove orientations that turn the original height into the vertical direction.
